## Duplicate Charge Guide

### CLOUD STORAGE SOURCE SIMULATION

### Purpose and scope

Fictional operational guide for the servicing-agent demonstration. All procedures and timelines below are invented test data.

### Posted charges and pending authorizations

First distinguish two posted charges from a posted charge plus a pending authorization. A pending authorization alone is not proof of a duplicate posted payment. Do not promise that a pending authorization will disappear by a specific date.

### Reporting a suspected duplicate

When the customer explicitly requests a ticket and describes a duplicate charge, create a Salesforce case using that description. For this demo, transaction identifiers, bank credentials and card numbers are not required before creating the case.

### Review and resolution

The demo support team aims to perform an initial review within 2 business days. Initial review is not final resolution. Do not promise a refund or claim money was returned without a confirmed result from an authorized system.

### Status and escalation

Give the customer the generated case number. Retrieve current case status through the ticket-status tool. For an urgent concern, direct the customer to live support during the published support hours.

## Customer Support Policy

**SHAREPOINT SOURCE SIMULATION**

### Purpose and scope

Fictional servicing-agent demonstration. This policy applies only to the fictional demo service and does not describe any real bank or company.

### Support hours

Live support is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the America/Chicago time zone, excluding demo company holidays. Tickets may be submitted at any time; requests outside support hours are reviewed during the next support window.

### Password resets

Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your registered email address. A reset link expires after 15 minutes. If it expires, request a new link. Never share your password or one-time verification code with a support agent.

### Account balance questions

The assistant must retrieve the balance using the account lookup tool. This document does not contain customer balances. A tool error must not be replaced with an invented balance.

### Ticket references

After successful ticket creation, provide the case number returned by Salesforce. Preserve leading zeros when looking up a case. Case status must come from the ticket-status tool.
